en.description:
Hooroo Game — AI-Powered Games That Get You Moving
Not sure what to play? Just tell Hooroo how you feel, what kind of games you enjoy, or how much time you have. Your AI game guide will recommend a motion game for the moment—so you can spend less time searching and more time playing.
Use your iPhone camera or Apple Watch to turn everyday movement into quick, interactive games. Move, play, and stay active—no traditional controller required.
AI GAME RECOMMENDATIONS
Tell Hooroo what you’re in the mood for—something relaxing, energetic, competitive, or quick. The AI game guide recommends games based on your preferences, conversations, and the types of games you enjoy playing.
PLAY USING YOUR BODY
Prop up your iPhone and let the camera recognize your movements. Jump, dodge, slash, stretch, and dance through supported games using your body as the controller.
APPLE WATCH MOTION CONTROL
Turn your Apple Watch into a motion controller. Play supported games with natural wrist and arm movements while viewing real-time heart rate and estimated calories burned.
QUICK GAMES FOR EVERY MOMENT
Take a three-minute movement break at work, enjoy a light cardio session at home, or unwind with a casual game after a long day. Hooroo makes it easier to add more movement to everyday life.
APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
Connect with Apple Health to record supported workout sessions, active calories, and exercise time. See how your play contributes to your daily activity goals.
PLAY TOGETHER ON THE BIG SCREEN
Mirror your iPhone to a compatible TV and bring motion games into the living room. Challenge friends and family, compare scores, and make game night more active.
Tell Hooroo what you want to play. Choose your control mode. Then move.



User Agreement: https://10m.com.cn/doc/browser/Terms_of_Services_en.html
Privacy Policy: https://10m.com.cn/doc/browser/Privacy_Policy_en.html
